execution_scope: Aggregate JSON arithmetic only; no model execution or patient processing.

eval_fix_same_weights.interpretation: No consistent direction detected in these final checkpoints; not an equivalence test. Shared patients/folds mean these are not 18 independent cohorts.

training_curves.interpretation: Strong evidence of late-stage validation deterioration under the recorded 30-epoch protocol. Observed validation maxima include selection bias and stochastic evaluation; not population-optimal epochs.

export_errors.note: Faulty per-arm wilson_ci intervals are excluded from acceptance. The headline bootstrap is separately recomputed.

limitations: Per-patient risks/logits, event/time arrays, original run logs and checkpoints not received in this public bundle.
Recorded source/checkpoint hashes are provenance claims, not locally rehashed server checkpoints.
Stored C-indices were aggregated; patient-level C-index calculations were not independently reconstructed.
Same-weight eval_fix comparison used final checkpoints, not independently selected best checkpoints.
